subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` hostname fallback contract, or should instance identity be provided only through standard OTel resource attributes or a maintainer-approved OpenClaw identity seam?
rationale: The patch is small, but choosing the persistent collector-visible instance identifier affects operator configuration, privacy, and future docs/API commitments; source inspection alone cannot decide that product contract.

options.title: Use standard OTel identity path
options.body: Remove the custom env knob and hostname fallback, then use `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the canonical issue's approved OpenClaw identity seam for `service.instance.id`.

options.title: Adopt the new env contract
options.body: Keep `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` only if maintainers explicitly own its precedence, docs, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause for canonical issue
options.body: Hold this PR until the open resource-identity issue settles the durable `service.instance.id` source and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Use standard OTel identity path
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env knob and hostname fallback, then use `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the canonical issue's approved OpenClaw identity seam for `service.instance.id`.

likelyOwner.reason: `bek91` owns the canonical resource-identity issue that already frames the product/API decision this PR is trying to implement.
